Container.Name: Fightarr
Container.Overview: UFC event manager for Usenet and Plex. Automatically searches, grabs, renames, and imports UFC fight cards — the Radarr for UFC that Radarr refuses to be.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Web UI and API port. Use 7879 to avoid conflict with Radarr (which also uses 7878). Access Fightarr at http://[IP]:[PORT:7879]/

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Stores the SQLite database and application config.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: UFC media library. Fightarr renames and imports fight cards here.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: Logging verbosity: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR

Config.Name: TMDB API Key
Config.Description: Optional. Enables higher-quality TMDB poster art. Poster art works out of the box via Wikipedia without this key.

Config.Name: Plex Host
Config.Description: Optional. Plex server URL for library refresh after import, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:32400

Config.Name: Plex Section ID
Config.Description: Optional. Plex library section ID to refresh. Leave blank to refresh all sections.

Config.Name: Jellyfin Host
Config.Description: Optional. Jellyfin server URL for library refresh after import, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8096

Config.Name: Schedule Refresh Interval
Config.Description: How often (seconds) to sync the UFC schedule from Wikipedia. Default: 21600 (6 hours).
